local_admission.key: SHA-256 of canonical schedule_sha256 plus run_id
local_admission.owner: one staged stage/session or one one-shot stage/receipt
local_admission.scope: cooperating processes of one UID on one host using one configured private registry root

adversarial_controls: Two prepared copies of one schedule/run cannot both spend a local tool-call cap of one.
Staged session and one-shot execution exclude each other in both winner orders before a losing reservation or launch.
Two independent CLI processes released at the claim boundary produce one winner and no reservation for the loser.
A crash after claim and before staged reservation permits only the same owner to resume; a one-shot claim survives a crash before its reservation and blocks another owner.
A pending or damaged staged reservation keeps the winner indeterminate and blocks a second stage.
Injected EIO in claim publication or claim reading blocks launch and never gives another owner a reservation.
A missing or malformed claim blocks a previously claimed local session.
Changing the configured registry root blocks an existing staged session; CLI checks the root override for staged and one-shot modes.

independent_review.result: No actionable finding in the declared host-local scope after reviewing claim publication, both execution paths, identity checks and failure behavior.
independent_review.tests_at_review: 54 affected tests passed; reviewer identified missing process-race and direct CLI override coverage, then three targeted tests were added without changing implementation code.
independent_review.limitations: The review did not establish power-loss survival, resistance to a hostile same-UID process, a cross-host budget, provider telemetry, or independent custody.

gates.command: ruff check scripts/local_run_admission.py scripts/staged_tool_session.py scripts/run_staged_local_tool.py tests/test_local_run_admission.py tests/test_staged_tool_session.py tests/test_run_staged_local_tool.py

limits: The registry works only when invokers cooperate on one private root; selecting another UID, host or root creates another scope.
The first local attempt has no implemented transition to a retry; the protocol requires documented external failure before a usable result and at most ten additional attempts studywide.
The local session budgets count local tool calls and observed sandbox time, not provider model activity, measured tokens or costs.
The runtime image is not verified; the registry and local sandbox do not supply independent custody, a blind evaluator or field evidence.
Process-crash and injected fsync errors were tested, not an actual power cut. Criterion 4 remains not assessed.
